image_description: A side-front view of a compact minibus parked on an asphalt road. The vehicle has a two-tone paint scheme: white on the upper half and purple/blue on the lower half, with a pinkish front bumper area. It features a row of rectangular passenger windows along the side, a large front windshield, and a visible sliding door track. The wheels are dark with red hubs/rims. There is some text on the side panel, though it appears slightly distorted or illegible. Trees and another vehicle are visible in the background.

There is a distinct hood/nose section ahead of the windshield, characteristic of a front-engine layout.
